seo.title: Use Cases
seo.description: See how VoiceBridge supports parents, therapy centers, schools, special education teachers, and NGOs and community health programs across South Asia and beyond.

hero.description: From parents at home to therapy centers to schools and NGOs — VoiceBridge adapts to where communication needs to happen.

parentAtHome.title: Parents & Primary Caregivers
parentAtHome.scenario: Aisha has a 7-year-old son who is largely non-verbal. Before VoiceBridge, she could only guess when he was hungry, thirsty, or in pain. Now his communication board lives on an old tablet by the couch. He taps what he needs, and Aisha gets a notification on her phone — even when she's in another room.
benefits: Know what your child needs in real-time
Build communication habits through daily use
Track which needs come up most often
Reduce frustration for both parent and child
Access communication history for doctor visits
parentAtHome.quote: "The crying jags from frustration have dropped so much. He can finally tell us he's in pain, or thirsty, or scared."

extendedFamily.title: Grandparents & Relatives
extendedFamily.scenario: Rehman looks after his grandson two days a week while his daughter works. Though he loves his grandson deeply, communication was always difficult and stressful. With VoiceBridge, even a grandparent with minimal tech experience can read the notification and respond to a need within seconds.
benefits: No technical expertise required to use
extendedFamily.quote: "I was nervous about looking after him. Now I feel confident. When he needs something, my phone tells me."

therapyCenter.title: Therapy Centers & Clinics
therapyCenter.scenario: A speech and language therapy center in Karachi onboarded 15 families in the first month. Therapists use the professional dashboard to view each client's communication board, track session progress, and add clinical notes that parents can access at home.
benefits: Centralized dashboard for all client families
Extends therapy impact into the home
therapyCenter.quote: "It bridges the gap between clinic and home. Parents see the same goals we're working on, every day."
therapyCenter.attribution: Director, KAR Speech and Language Clinic

specialEdSchool.title: Schools & Special Education Programs
specialEdSchool.scenario: A special needs school uses VoiceBridge in classrooms alongside traditional AAC methods. Teachers configure shared classroom boards with common phrases. Students who previously struggled to communicate with teaching staff are now expressing themselves independently.
specialEdSchool.quote: "Three of our students who had never communicated independently are now initiating communication every day."

specialEdTeacher.title: Special Education Teachers
specialEdTeacher.scenario: Mrs. Sana teaches a class of 8 children with varying communication needs. She uses VoiceBridge to create individual boards for each student, and a shared class board for common needs like "bathroom", "water", and "all done". She monitors communications from the teacher dashboard during class.
benefits: Customize boards per student's IEP goals
specialEdTeacher.quote: "It's the first tool that works for all my students, not just some of them."

ngoProgram.title: NGOs & Community Health Programs
ngoProgram.scenario: An NGO running communication support programs for people of determination across rural Punjab distributes tablets pre-loaded with VoiceBridge to families who can't afford traditional AAC devices. The Urdu language support and low device requirements make it accessible even in lower-resource settings.
benefits: Low hardware requirements — runs on old tablets
No ongoing subscription cost for basic use
Train families in group onboarding sessions
ngoProgram.quote: "We've given voices to children who never had access to communication tools before. The impact is profound."
ngoProgram.attribution: Program Director, People of Determination Support Foundation

cta.description: Whatever your situation, VoiceBridge can be customized to fit. Start here today — no commitment required.
